description: Moral sway continuum, Bystander Corridor, and micro-verb weight matrix

bystander_corridor.description: The zone of everyday survival and pragmatic hesitation where micro-actions accumulate moral inertia before tipping into active ideological alignment.

micro_verbs.description: Altruistically covers Eric's rent arrears, preventing eviction.
Places consecrated flowers and oils on Monica's woodland altar.
Refuses to execute a disarmed foe, granting safe passage.
Cleans and recalibrates the familial clock mechanism.
Looting domestic reserves without asking permission.
Plundering holy relics and knocking down devotional candles.
Striking down an incapacitated combatant to harvest shadow essence.
Threatening merchants for discounted armaments or potions.
